name: Bitwarden / Vaultwarden
description: Bots sign in with usernames, passwords and one-time codes from Bitwarden or self-hosted Vaultwarden.

setup.title: Connect a Bitwarden / Vaultwarden instance
setup.description: Configure each Bitwarden Cloud or self-hosted Vaultwarden account as a separate instance. OutcomeGo verifies login, vault unlock, and sync on the bot computer before marking the instance Connected.
steps: In the web vault, open Settings → Security → Keys → View API key and copy the personal client ID and client secret (organization API keys are not supported).
Enter the HTTPS server origin, account email, personal API client ID, personal API client secret and master password, then save and connect.
OutcomeGo checks the connection on the bot computer with Bitwarden CLI 2026.10.1, sets the instance name to the account email by default, and marks it Connected only after verification succeeds.

fields.label: Server URL
fields.helpText: HTTPS origin reachable from the bot computer. For Bitwarden Cloud use https://vault.bitwarden.com or https://vault.bitwarden.eu.

fields.label: Master password
fields.helpText: Used to unlock the vault. Leading and trailing spaces are significant.

installationSteps: Use a dedicated Bitwarden or Vaultwarden account with access only to the logins bots need. Grant read access to the required collections where your provider supports it. Add multiple instances below when bots need access to more than one vault.
In the web vault, open Settings → Security → Keys → View API key. Copy the personal client ID and client secret; organization API keys are not supported.

Configure each instance with its HTTPS server origin, account email, API key and master password. The bot computer must resolve and reach that origin and trust its TLS certificate. Its localhost is the computer container itself.

The skill installs verified Bitwarden CLI 2026.10.1 on first use. Linux and macOS on x64/ARM64 require Python 3, curl and unzip. Each instance is verified on the bot computer before showing Connected, and each read authenticates and syncs afresh.

The wrapper exposes reads only; general Shell access is broader. Credentials read by a bot enter Computer's short-lived memory and browser secret fill rather than model context. Replace individual fields in an instance to rotate them, or rename duplicate email instances with custom aliases.

skills.name: bitwarden
skills.description: Read saved website logins and one-time codes from Bitwarden or Vaultwarden. Use when the user requests credentials or a website needs a username, password or verification code.
